Include: RQ coverage/status table; eight fact sheets; system-layer classification; cross-repository capability matrix; documentation-versus-implementation divergences; what each external project has that Cyberalchemy does not propose; what Cyberalchemy evidences that each lacks on inspected surfaces; gap versus deliberate/undecided boundary classifications; and a reuse matrix with candidate, actual owner or prior-art qualification, concrete witness, evidence mode, definitional soundness, boundary fit, dependencies/license, uncertainty, verdict and use mode.
